run: cd graphiti/mcp_server && docker compose up   (FalkorDB default; Neo4j optional)
claude_code: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http graphiti http://localhost:8000/mcp/

env.OPENAI_API_KEY: <KEY or configure Ollama/other provider in config.yaml>

notes: Needs an LLM + embedder for entity extraction; with a cloud provider your memories are sent to that provider. Use Ollama for fully local.
